chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

Indeed, Adam complained to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, about what he was encountering of inner whispering and grief. So Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended upon him and said to him: O Adam, say: 'There is no power nor strength except by Allah.' So he said it, and the whispering and the grief departed from him.

key_terms.الوسوسة: Whispering, intrusive thoughts; inner distress caused by the self or Satan
key_terms.لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله: There is no power nor strength except by Allah (la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah); a powerful dhikr formula

ai.seo_question: What did Gabriel teach Adam to relieve his grief and anxiety?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) narrated that Adam, after his descent from Paradise, suffered from inner distress and sadness. Allah sent Gabriel to teach him the formula 'la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah' (there is no power nor strength except by Allah). Upon reciting it, Adam's whispering thoughts and grief were relieved. This demonstrates the power of this dhikr formula as a remedy for anxiety and sorrow, established from the very beginning of human history.
